limitations: AutoMasker requires CATVTON_USE_AUTOMASKER=true and importable detectron2.
Default mask is cloth-region OpenCV GrabCut; box_fallback is refused when REQUIRE_REAL.
Garment silhouette mask is computed but not passed to native CatVTON (native uses person mask + cloth image).
fit_preference / background_action are accepted by the API but unused.
RTX 3050 6GB uses 512x512 and limited steps vs upstream 768x1024 / 50 steps.
